def test_content_notices_are_separate_exact_lexical_observations(self):
        record = self.by_id['TCE-0257']
        self.assertTrue(record['contentNotice'])
        self.assertEqual({n['type'] for n in record['contentNotice']}, {'sexual_reference'})
        for item in record['contentNotice']:
            self.assertIn(item['trigger'], record[item['language']])
        self.assertNotIn('sexual_reference', record['issues'])
        self.assertEqual(len(self.records), 500)  # No notice-based default exclusion.
